rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial expression for hiring someone to work for you.

example.english: We need to hire someone for our shop.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 jiu3 ceng2 jan4

rows.note: Use this more formal verb when describing employing a person, especially in business or written contexts.

example.english: The company decided to hire three new employees.
example.traditional: 公司決定僱用三名新員工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gu3 jung6 saam1 ming4 san1 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for paying to use a vehicle, item, or premises for a period of time.

example.english: I want to hire a car for three days.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou1 saam1 jat6 ce1
